evidence: Default sort by Priority groups all High tasks first, then Medium, then Low. After editing a task's priority from High to Low, it moved to the end of the list confirming live re-sort by priority.
Switching Sort by to Deadline reordered active tasks ascending: Sep 4, Sep 7, Sep 10, Sep 16.

issue: Cannot modify content/priority of tasks with an incomplete prerequisite
actual: Per the spec, a task with an unmet prerequisite should still allow modification of description and priority fields. Instead, the Edit (pen) button is fully disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) for such tasks (e.g. "Complete tax filing"), and clicking it does nothing - no edit dialog opens at all, so description and priority cannot be modified either. Editing only works for tasks without pending prerequisites.

evidence: Created "Test Task Alpha" via Add Task dialog; toast "Task created" shown and task appeared in Active list, active count incremented 5->6.
Title "Test Task Alpha", Description "This is a test description", Deadline 2026-09-10 (displayed as "Sep 10") all saved and displayed correctly on the created task card.

Edited task (title/description/priority saved, toast "Task updated"), marked a task complete (toast, moved to Completed tab), and deleted a task (toast "Task deleted", removed from list, counts updated).

Clicked complete toggle on "Schedule dentist appointment"; it moved from Active (5) to Completed (3) tab, counts updated correctly (5 active/2 completed -> 5/3... verified via header text "5 active, 3 completed").
Page loads by default on the "Active" tab, displaying only non-completed/ongoing tasks; a separate "Completed" tab holds finished tasks.
Created a task with "Buy groceries" as a prerequisite (single); pre-existing "Submit final report" task shows "2 prerequisites incomplete" demonstrating multiple prerequisite binding works.

Tasks with incomplete prerequisites show disabled Edit and Complete buttons with classes "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50" / "text-muted-foreground/40 cursor-not-allowed" (visually grayed out). After the prerequisite ("Buy groceries") was completed, both buttons became enabled automatically.
Tasks with unmet prerequisites display a prominent label such as "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" or "2 prerequisites incomplete".

Complete toggle button for a task with unmet prerequisite is disabled and unclickable (Playwright click timed out: "element is not enabled"). After prerequisite was completed, the toggle became enabled.

"Buy groceries" is a prerequisite of "Test Task Alpha Edited". Opening the Edit dialog for "Buy groceries" shows its Prerequisites checklist without "Test Task Alpha Edited" as an option, preventing the reverse/circular dependency.
"Create Task" button remains disabled when the Title field is empty or contains only whitespace ("   "), preventing task creation without a title.

Deadline field is a native HTML5 input[type=date], which structurally enforces a valid YYYY-MM-DD date format; entered values (e.g. 2026-09-10) were always stored/displayed in correct ISO date format.

issue: Past deadline dates are accepted without validation
actual: Entered deadline "2020-01-01" (a past date relative to current date 2026-09-02) in the Create Task form; the Create Task button remained enabled and the task was created successfully with a toast "Task created". The task then displayed with an "Overdue: Jan 1" label in the active list instead of being blocked from creation.

evidence: Completed tasks ("Reply to client emails", "Organize desk", "Schedule dentist appointment", "Buy groceries") remain visible under the "Completed" tab after being marked complete; they are not deleted and the completed count increments accordingly.

issue: No details popup appears when hovering over a generic task
actual: Hovered over task cards without dependency badges (e.g. "Review project proposal", "Test Task Alpha Edited" heading, whole card container) - verified via DOM query for [role="tooltip"] elements, none were rendered/visible. Only tasks displaying a dependency badge ("Prerequisite incomplete" / "N prerequisite(s) completed") show a tooltip on hover, but plain task hover produces no details pop-up.

evidence: When the Title field is empty, the "Create Task" button is rendered in a disabled state (grayed out, non-interactive), providing clear visual feedback that a title is required.

Hovering over the "Prerequisite incomplete" badge or the "N prerequisite(s) completed" badge triggers a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing each prerequisite task name and its status (e.g. "Review project proposal - pending", "Buy groceries" for a completed one).

Each task card displays the title (heading), due date (e.g. "Sep 4", "Tomorrow", "Overdue: Jan 1"), and completion status is indicated both by tab placement (Active vs Completed) and by a distinct check-circle icon/button state per task.
